exposure: Robson's 10-group classification system (based on parity, previous obstetric record, course of labor including pre-labor duration, and gestational age)
cohort: The study included 1727 women who delivered at a semi-urban hospital over a one-year period from January 2018 to December 2018, of whom 715 underwent lower segment caesarean section.
finding: The overall Caesarean section rate was 42% (41.4% for lower segment CS), with Robson's Group 5 contributing the most (19%) to this rate, followed by Group 1 (6.5%) and Group 2 (5.6%).
mod_finding: The overall Caesarean section rate was 42%, with specific contributions from different Robson's groups, indicating variations in CS rates based on maternal and pregnancy characteristics.
gest_age: gestational age was recorded and used as a criterion for Robson's classification
